extraction.name: VideoChat-Flash
extraction.description: A video MLLM model for long-context video modeling
extraction.creator: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset LongVid comprises 114,228 long videos and 3,444,849 question-answering (QA) pairs across five different task types, supporting models to handle diverse long video scenarios. The videos of LongVid are curated from 4 open-source video datasets: Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, and MiraData.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Document analysis, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection includes 300,000 hours of videos and 2 billion words of textual annotations.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The video context compression is divided into two stages: 1. Clip-level Compression during the encoding of long videos. 2. Video-level Compression within the context interaction in the LLM.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For data curation, we generate dense event labels for each long video. Specifically, we utilize existing high-quality short video captions (Panda-70M for HD-VILA, CosMo for HowTo100M, Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D, and the original high-quality captions provided in MiraData) and filter the consecutive segments that can be regroup into a long video sequence, then we construct a sequence of event labels with their corresponding timestamps for every long video based on their captions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The model is evaluated on various video-linguistic benchmarks, including two short video benchmarks: MVBench and Perception Test, and three long video benchmarks: LongVideoBench, MLVU, and LVBench, and a comprehensive benchmark, VideoMME.
